useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

skipZeros.description: If `true`, skips zero values in target `targetOutput` to avoid undefined result.

title:
{@link MlMeanAbsolutePercentageErrorMetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE)} metric computes the average
absolute percentage error between the predicted value and target value. It is primarily used for regression problems.
The metric is sensitive to relative errors and is not affected by scale of the target variable.
The `modelOutput` and `targetOutput` are expected to have the same shape.
This metric supports `sampleWeights` as `context`. `sampleWeights` is single-dimensional with same number of samples
as the `modelOutput`. It represents a per-sample weighting when aggregating for MAPE calculation.
name: MlMeanAbsolutePercentageErrorMetric
